lines: Travel 2 tiles to forest floor.
It followed you. The Big-Eyes is here.
Nothing left to take here today.
Travel 2 tiles to trail edge.
It followed you. The Big-Eyes is here.
Nothing left to take here today.

The Big-Eyes stops at the boundary — pacing, unwilling. Something else is already here. It's still out there.
Nothing left to take here today.
Travel 3 tiles to Haven.
The pantry is bursting past tomorrow — most of the haul stays in your pack. The fire can wait; the road can't.
You keep a day's food (2425 kcal) — nothing extra for the pantry this time.
1 unprocessed haul onto the counter — the clock is ticking.
Nobody at the fire knows your haul any better than you do. It'll be your own hands that teach you.
You walk back into Haven. 35 Codex entries. The village is glad to see you.
You catch fragments by the fire — Qori telling Nikos about themself. Three retellings in, nobody remembers what actually happened — but everyone has opinions.
🚶 Qori is back — found Raj.
🪤 Giulia is back. "Snares were empty. They'll keep."
Stan heads out to forage. "Out for a forage. If I'm late, start without me."
🪤 Amina is back. "Snares were empty. They'll keep."
👥 Raj heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself."
👥 Qori walks out with Raj. "Nobody walks alone today."
Iron cold. Even the ticks are shelved.
— MIDDAY — Honest work hours. Heat builds.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
Qori stopped asking. They just started organizing the Fish crews. Nobody stopped them.
You catch fragments by the fire — Amina telling Chloe about you. The truth left this story two fires ago. What's left is better theater.
Amina heads out to check the snares. "Wire doesn't lie."
🚶 Nikos is back — found Mpumelelo.
🌿 Chloe returns from foraging the wilds: +147 kcal to the pantry — the shelves are full, so 147 kcal is eaten at the fire instead.
— DUSK — Animals stir again. Shadows lengthen.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.

🍖 FEAST 📺 — Felipe opens the pantry wide: 23× Blackberry, 1× Foraged food, 1× Muscadine Grapes (dried). Mpumelelo, Giulia, Nikos, Chloe eat until the fire burns low. Somebody tells the story again, the one everybody already knows. For one evening, hunger feels like a rumor. (−2,084 kcal from the pantry) The channeled keepsake feeds the feast — the feast was the weapon, and the surge rides the fire until tomorrow's dawn, spent only when the blades are warmed. (FEAST SURGE ×1.5 armed)
🍖 The feast carries you on — the fire is stoked higher, not doubled. FEASTED ×2.03 until tomorrow's dawn (6 parts left): a proper feast. (Re-feast refreshes; it never stacks.)
Giulia sets out to find Qori. "Won't be long."
Nikos sets out to find Qori. "Won't be long."
Chloe heads out for water. "Water first. Everything else waits."
Giulia shakes their head, admiring. "Did you hear what Stan did?" You hadn't. Now you have.
— NIGHT — Camp. Rest — or risk the dark.
Night settles. The fire is the whole world now. No watches posted. The dark feels bigger than it should.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.

💛 You hold Carpenter's square. Your first solo frame, checked and found true. The nod that followed was the whole ceremony. Measure twice, cut once — it's in your hands now. Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, and they are with you. The feast was the weapon. (The next feast grants FEASTED until tomorrow's dawn: strikes & abilities uplifted, devotion ×1.5 — richer feasts hit harder.)
Travel 1 tile to trail edge.
You catch fragments by the fire — Chantal telling Qori about Raj. The story's getting bigger than what happened.
You work the patch with practiced hands: 10× Blackberry (650 kcal). This patch is picked clean — it'll recover in a few days.
Giulia forages the bushes.
Travel 1 tile to Haven.
The pantry is bursting past tomorrow — most of the haul stays in your pack. The fire can wait; the road can't.
You keep a day's food (3075 kcal) — nothing extra for the pantry this time.
You walk back into Haven. 35 Codex entries. The village is glad to see you.
You catch fragments by the fire — Qori telling Amina about Nikos. Someone's added a flourish that wasn't there this morning.
Stan picks through the bag, frowning. Nothing they can name with confidence. (8 ticks)
Donated Blackberry (+650 kcal). Trust +0. They'll remember this.
You coax 4 growing beds forward by 12 days. The next harvest carries the growth magic.
(−200 kcal — food becomes green whisper.)
You settle into the hall floor. Sleep takes you.
You catch fragments by the fire — Chantal telling Stan about Raj. Half of it's true anymore. You're not sure which half.
🌿 Stan returns from foraging the wilds: +234 kcal to the pantry — the shelves are full, so 233 kcal is eaten at the fire instead.
Someone walks in like they belong here, grinning. "Heard about this place three valleys over. Had to see it." The System's show has an audience, and audiences talk.
★ IDENTIFIED: Poison Hemlock. Tall white umbels on smooth stems blotched purple. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
SYSTEM: Oh! It has a NAME. You all love names.
📚 Village knowledge: Nikos taught everyone about Poison Hemlock. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. The spiral has started.
Village meal: +2348 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry.
Chloe paces the hall, restless, then sits. Then paces.
Chloe has been asking about the strange leaves all week — "but what IS it?" Tonight, an answer. Nikos drew Poison Hemlock in the dirt for the others. It'll wash away. The knowledge won't.

Mpumelelo spends the afternoon with the tree with lobed leaves and oval nuts in scaly caps — look, smell, the smallest taste, then waiting. Raw, it knots the stomach. Cooked... fine. The fire learns the rule before the name: cook it, or else.
From the lumped bag: White Oak Acorns — named, and out.
★ IDENTIFIED: White Oak Acorns. White oak acorn. Lobed leaves, sweet acorns. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
💡 White Oak Acorns. The tree with lobed leaves and oval nuts in scaly caps you've been looking at for days finally has a name, and now you'll never unsee it.
SYSTEM: Oh! It has a NAME. You all love names.
Chantal was watching. Now they know White Oak Acorns too.
The Codex notes it: White Oak Acorns — cook it, or else. (Mpumelelo tested it.)
Raj: "Muscadine Grapes is coming back thick on the damp slope. Not new — but it's holding."
🍽️ Amina weighs the day's basket against the pantry shelves and puts it down. "Enough. Carving bowls instead — we're down to the cracked ones."
🍽️ Qori carries the day's surplus to the pantry door, thinks better of it, and turns back to the fire. "It'll only rot in there. We eat."
💧 The cistern won't cover today — the hall's call, no vote needed: half rations until the water runs come back.
📖 LEARNED: Forage Identification (Level 2). Deeper understanding of forage identification.
📖 LEARNED: Solar Disinfection (Level 2). Paint half the bottle black — heats faster, kills more. Shake first to oxygenate.
📖 LEARNED: Scrounger (Level 2). Ruins give up their secrets to you.
🌟 JACKPOT: A stranger by the road knows things. They talk for an hour. You learn: Forage Identification, Solar Disinfection, Scrounger. Your Codex overflows.
— DAY 82 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
Overnight, Muscadine Grapes went bad — beyond saving. You leave it for the flies.
Fresh food keeps days, not weeks. Smoke it over a fire to make it last.
The fire burns low. 2 new lines in the journal tonight — loudest: Poison Hemlock — named and noted.
💬 Giulia says: "Someone's been leaving food out. Good food. Don't ask me how I know it wasn't one of us."
Mpumelelo Baloyi reads the sky: rain tomorrow, freezing.
Dawn. You wake rested. (+0 health, energy restored. By the fire. Good enough.)
